description:
The unsigned calldata to take lent USDG back: withdraw(usdg, account, account), or redeem(all shares, account, account) for
        'all' (exact, no dust). insufficient_balance when the account holds less, insufficient_liquidity when the vault's idle USDG plus
        the market's unborrowed supply cannot pay it now. You send it with the account's own owner key; this server never sends.
name: lend_withdraw_quote
